items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I used to follow him around just like I followed Fats Waller... I used to hang around Fats and go into theatres and listen to him play

ctx.x: Yeah. And I used to follow him around just like I followed Fats Waller. When I first came to New York, all I did was follow Fats Waller.
